description: Version-accurate Symfony expertise for coding agents: API Platform v4, Doctrine ORM 3, TDD with Pest & PHPUnit, Messenger, security, and pragmatic architecture.

api-platform.label: API Platform
api-platform.summary: Resources, filters, serialization, state providers/processors, security and versioning for API Platform v4.

doctrine.label: Doctrine ORM
doctrine.summary: Entity mapping, relations, migrations, transactions, fetch modes, batch processing and lifecycle events.

testing.label: Tests & TDD
testing.summary: RED-GREEN-REFACTOR with Pest or PHPUnit, functional and E2E tests, fixtures and test doubles.

messenger.label: Messenger & async
messenger.summary: Async message handling, retry and failure strategies, scheduling, CQRS buses.

security.label: Security
security.summary: Voters, access control, rate limiting, form validation and input handling.

architecture.label: Architecture & services
architecture.summary: Lean controllers, autowiring, ports & adapters, value objects, caching and UI components.

workflow.label: Workflow & onboarding
workflow.summary: Project bootstrap, runner selection, planning, daily workflow and quality gates.
